External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.title: ModelBindingRevision
External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.description: Immutable logical-model binding from a public model name to engine, artifacts, execution recipe, parameter domains, capacity manifest, and qualification evidence. It is separate from any runtime instance, generation, lease, or readiness fact.

revision_id.description: Globally unique immutable identifier for this exact (binding_id, revision). Capacity manifests, qualification reports, runtime instances, leases, submit intents, and receipts use this value as binding_revision_id.

logical_model.description: Public logical model name returned by GET /v1/models and accepted in model request fields. It is not an engine model path.

release_tier.description: Publication claim for this revision. A draft may target production without evidence identifiers; any published, retired, or disabled production revision requires the bound capacity manifest and qualification report.

publication.description: Mutable lifecycle projection over the immutable binding definition. Drafts cannot carry publication timestamps or evidence identifiers.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

examples.description: File and full-segment review ASR binding.
Realtime ASR binding with VAD preview and full-segment review.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.
